content.text: {"name": "Hours-to-flow spread conditioned on high T regime", "hypothesis": "In high-T regimes, groups whose average hours (V01 6-month change) rise relative to the stock rate V06 (standardized) earn higher next-month relative returns, since hours expansion without rising slack signals strengthening demand.", "falsified_if": "In development data, high-T-regime mean IC of this feature is zero or negative, or its HAC t-stat is below 1.", "expression": "regime(spread(chg(V01,6),tsz(V06,60)),\"high\")"}
